name: Alex
source:
Alex is a young man who lives as a doctor in the countryside, which is mostly inhabited by elderly people. He travels to the capital, healing girls with his Medica Skill, which allows him to cure diseases through sex.

"If you want to cure the Hero Syndrome, have sex with me!"
